issues.description: New side effect of the round-1 move fix: the source cell goes through checkEntryWrite, whose first check is «future day», so moving an existing row OUT of a future-dated day (e.g. to today) is now refused for everyone, managers included; on origin/master it was allowed (only the target was checked). Future-dated rows exist only via PATCH or pre-created document rows, and the UI clients that send entryId are tracked-document and climate; delete + re-add still works. Not covered by the spec (which keeps writes INTO future days closed). Optional smallest change: for the source, apply checkEntryScope and the past-day locks but skip the future-day check.
issues.repro: Owner PATCH /api/journal-documents/<doc>/entries {entries:[{employeeId: owner, date: today+2, data}]} → 200; free owner's today cell; owner PUT {entryId: <that row>, employeeId: owner, date: today, data} → 403 future_day_locked «Нельзя заполнять журнал будущим числом…». raw/verifier-round2/verifier2-e2e-output.txt MV-12.

issues.description: Pre-existing, not introduced here: in an automation document DELETE {employeeId, date} collects ALL of the employee's rows as candidates (the date is not in the filter), so deleting a single in-window (or today's) cell is refused with past_day_locked whenever the employee has any older locked row. The UI never sends this form (grids send ids, hygiene/health send employeeId only), so the window rule works from the UI; fix by adding the date to the candidate filter when body.date is set.
issues.repro: Own automation hygiene document, window 3, owner has rows 6 and 1 days ago: DELETE {employeeId: owner, date: yesterday} → 403; DELETE {ids: [yesterday's row]} → 200 (raw/verifier-round2/ad6-probe-output.txt).
